supersession.futureEvidenceAcquisitionEntryOnly: propose capture without prior H/F0/F1 qualification; reviewable diagnostic policy, not product or performance acceptance

objective: capture unprofiled lower-cost to higher-cost natural queries, and live multi-second stalls in one preserved Peer process; causal mechanism remains a later evidence requirement

process.beforeAttachHistory: explicit gap, never reconstructed from a fresh process

history.start: first installed observation, including pre-baseline and failed/incomplete records
history.disk: append-only sequenced hash-linked chunks, fsync before ACK; never overwrite archived prefix
history.eventIncludes: all prior chunks, not only a recent ring
history.readProvenance: pid/birth/build/observer generation + scope hash + query graph/ordered ports + dependency epoch + counts/output identity
history.unversionedDependencyOrSourceWatcherOnly: retain candidate, identityIncomplete; no same-input mechanism conclusion
history.sourceChanges: archive transition and keep recording; never merge baselines across epochs; >4 cohorts stop comparability coverage
history.fullHistoryDefinition: complete observed prefix from attach, with event sequence, versions and diagnostic boundaries; not VM instruction replay or birth history

secondary: 12 Evidence CPU vectors and GC overlap
metrics.cpuAttribution: thread CPU only for contiguous synchronous roots/spans; asynchronous entries retain wall/parents without attributing interleaved thread CPU

baseline.selection: first nine complete natural roots in chronological order; no warm/GC/heap/speed filtering
baseline.ifUnavailable: wall and heartbeat triggers still run; after 10 minutes no comparable baseline => seal coverage-insufficient

triggers.newEntry: coverage metadata only, not automatic controlled exposure
triggers.busy: merge reasons for same in-flight episode; no queued business reads

firstWitness.beforeProfiler: fsync complete history and first returned anomaly, then observe first three subsequent complete same-cohort natural roots; no GC filtering and no active query
firstWitness.wholeQueryChangeCandidate: all 3 subsequent root user deltas >=25ms and >=8%, with identity complete; baseline dispersion always reported; not old G2 or proof of mechanism
firstWitness.evidenceOnly: Evidence increase without root increase is a redistribution candidate, not proof of whole-app slowdown
firstWitness.alreadySlowOnAttach: entry anomaly only; never claim observed fast history
firstWitness.otherDiagnosticOverlap: first three natural followups are not replaced if an OS sample overlaps; retain phase and classify natural CPU confirmation incomplete

callChains.logical: capture actual entry and each Evidence caller with root/span IDs and ALS parent links while calls occur; do not reuse a first-kind stack as current chain
callChains.completeness: truncated, unmapped or missing async parent => chainIncomplete, never guessed from timestamp proximity
callChains.nativeStall: one external sample attempt, 2 seconds at 1ms, 5-second child wall deadline, no Peer kill; JIT addresses may remain unknown
callChains.cpuHotspots: only after unprofiled first witness + three natural followups are sealed; one 500us V8 profile, <=10 seconds, scheduled at next natural entry with 30-second admission wait
callChains.localSessionStartStop: bounded existing inspector interface; exact installed Electron behavior remains a functional prerequisite
callChains.unknownStartOrStop: do not start again; bounded stop/disable/disconnect, retain unknown effects; no clean status until verified
callChains.nativeSamplingOverlap: mark every intersecting root/span as sampler-overlap; pre-sample stall onset retained, sampled tail not unperturbed; no CPU deduction or replacement roots

coverage.onlyOneBackgroundPollOrNoBaseline: seal coverage-insufficient at 10 minutes, do not extend or fabricate activity

budget.lastSynchronousOvershoot: preserve actual overshoot and stop new diagnostic admission; never terminate actual Peer

preparation.qualifiesOnly: transparency, coverage, timestamps, history durability, unknown outcomes, stop/recovery; never product cause or low-interference proof
preparation.ifFailure: retain slot/cost and stop, no extra qualification process

stops: first episode and bounded optional stack collection sealed; no waiting to fill unused event quotas
first CPU and stall episode quotas consumed and followups sealed
1500 natural roots /10000 entries /4 cohorts /metadata or output cap
2ms per-root self CPU or3s cumulative probe CPU exceeded
unarchived record gap or byte cap / failed fsync / transport outcome unknown
profiler recovery unknown / external sampler deadline
user cancellation or controller lease expiration

recovery.failOpen: original product methods continue; only diagnostic admission ends
stopOrder: recover original unACKed batch without new query
restore original method owners without overwriting later owners
close only owned Inspector and prove refusal while Peer lives
recovery.ifMainBlocked: stop external admissions now; in-main restoration deferred until it can run, record unverified; never restart or kill Peer

validationRequiredBeforeExecution: one functional Electron slot only; no new performance qualification
every pre-baseline row retained and contemporaneous caller stacks, not cached-kind stacks
zero heap statistics, controlled requests, native priming or GC
live stall watchdog works while main cannot drain diagnostics
durable original-batch recovery / unknown result / later-owner protection / lease-stop / port refusal
measured self CPU and metadata command whole-window upper charged separately; no neutrality claim

episodeReservation.lateSignal: archive only; do not start unreserved waiting/profile/sample
episodeReservation.noNeedToSpendOtherEventQuota: stop once the first episode and bounded optional stack collection are sealed; unused quota retired, not required
